address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x70`. `0x56` is also configurable - see datasheet.

*See also: [QMP6988 Temperature+Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/qmp6988#configuration-variables)*

iir_filter.docs:
Set up an Infinite Impulse Response filter to increase accuracy. One of `OFF`, `2x`, `4x`, `8x`, `16x`, `32x`. Defaults to `OFF`.

*See also: [QMP6988 Temperature+Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/qmp6988#configuration-variables)*

oversampling.docs:
The oversampling parameter for the temperature sensor. See [Oversampling Options](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/qmp6988#qmp6988-oversampling).

*See also: [QMP6988 Temperature+Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/qmp6988#configuration-variables)*
